# From the published reference, not a local install:
# https://www.fastly.com/documentation/reference/cli/secret-store-entry/create/
# and the flag definitions in https://github.com/fastly/cli/blob/main/pkg/commands/secretstoreentry/create.go
fastly secret-store-entry create
  --name        Secret name
  --store-id    Store ID
  --file        Read secret value from file instead of prompt
  --recreate    Recreate secret by name (errors if secret doesn't already exist)
  --recreate-allow  Create or recreate secret by name
  --stdin       Read secret value from STDIN instead of prompt
